name: apple-cards-carousel
title: Apple Cards Carousel
blurb: Scrollable carousel with explicit arrow buttons and click-to-modal card…
description: Horizontal scrollable carousel with navigation buttons for left/right scroll. Cards expand to full-screen modal with backdrop blur. Uses Framer Motion layout animations for smooth transitions between states.
use_when: Showcasing cards in a carousel with explicit scroll controls and click-to-detail modals.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where scroll buttons may be hard to use.
a11y: Scroll buttons disabled when at carousel bounds. Cards handle Escape key and outside-click close. Modal has proper focus trapping.
